learning_outcomes.text: Master the fundamentals of computer science and object-oriented programming using the formal language ANSI-C++ as an example.
Use static and dynamic data structures.
Handle the concepts of overriding, overloading, and extending.
Understand basic concepts like scheduling and priorities.
Implement and commission embedded mechatronic systems in further qualifications or in a professional context.

syllabus_topics: Class concepts, methods, attributes, abstract classes
Static and dynamic data structures such as linked lists, stack, queue, containers
Scheduling, priorities, processes, threads under Linux
assessment_rules: Student knowledge will be assessed by a graded written module examination of 90 minutes duration. The module grade for MECB240 corresponds to the grade for MECB241. MECB242 Computer Science 2 Lab is assessed and certified without a grade through laboratory work accompanying the semester. An examination prerequisite XP (report, elaboration of a programming example, or similar) will be defined at the beginning of the semester.
